summary.text: The centaur who fought with an axe among the five Caeneus killed at Peirithous' wedding.

story.text: Ovid's Nestor names Pyracmos with his axe as the fifth of the centaurs Caeneus put to death — the only one of the five singled out by his weapon before Latreus mocked the Lapith and the whole brood buried him under pines.
